column1: # Seed quests. Gary uses these until sync.py has written quests.tsv from the backend.
# Columns are separated by TABs: id, target, xp, text, and optionally "herd".
# "target" must be a name from models/coco_labels.txt or models/gary_nature_labels.txt (bottle, backpack, bench, dog, bird, bicycle ...).
# A quest marked herd only completes with a friend in the frame.
